import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Prefix {
    static final int SIZE = 1000010;
    static final long MAXN = 1000000007L;

    static long ways;
    static int P, K;
    static int[] Parent = new int[SIZE];
    static int[] Rank = new int[SIZE];
    static Set<Integer> groups = new HashSet<>();

    static int findParent(int nd) {
        if (Parent[nd] != nd)
            Parent[nd] = findParent(Parent[nd]);
        return Parent[nd];
    }

    static void union(int nd1, int nd2) {
        if (Rank[nd1] >= Rank[nd2]) {
            Parent[nd2] = nd1;
            Rank[nd1]++;
        } else {
            Parent[nd1] = nd2;
            Rank[nd2]++;
        }
    }

    static long fastExpPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % mod;
            }
            exp >>= 1;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        P = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            Parent[i] = i;
            Rank[i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            long val = ((long) K * i) % P;
            int Pa = findParent(i);
            int Pb = findParent((int) val);
            if (Pa != Pb) {
                union(Pa, Pb);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++) {
            groups.add(findParent(i));
        }

        if (K == 0) {
            ways = fastExpPow(P, P - 1, MAXN);
        } else if (K == 1) {
            ways = fastExpPow(P, P, MAXN);
        } else {
            ways = fastExpPow(P, groups.size(), MAXN);
        }

        System.out.println(ways);
    }
}
